name: 321Movies UK
description: 321Movies UK — movies & TV series from 321movies.co.uk (TMDB catalog). Real HLS sources from the site's own player (Cascade, StreamAggregator, Surge, Movy…), each probed before it is offered; Hindi audio first.

name: CineFreak
description: CineFreak (cinefreak.net) — Hindi, English, dual-audio movies, web series & K-Drama. Direct 480p/720p/1080p files from the site's own player, with automatic stream preparation.

name: CineHD
description: CineHD (cinehd.vc) — movies & series from a TMDB catalog with many servers per title (MhPly/AwsPly Hindi, Nitro multi-audio, HDHub, Rock HLS, MovieBox, VidAPI…). Every link is checked before it is shown; Hindi first.

name: CineJoy
description: CineJoy (cinejoy.pk) — movies & series from a TMDB catalog (Netflix/Prime rows) with many servers per title: Nitro multi-audio, MhPly/AwsPly Hindi, HDHub, VidAPI, MovieBox, Rock HLS. Links are checked before they are shown.

name: DesiDubAnime
description: DesiDubAnime (desidubanime.me) - Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and multi-audio dubbed anime series and movies. Full episode lists with titles, played as HLS from the site's own P2PPlay (Cloudflare and direct) and VidMoly servers with English subtitles; each link is checked before it is shown.

name: DesiSerialOnline
description: DesiSerialOnline / Yo Desi Serial (desiserialonline.su) - daily Hindi TV serials and reality shows (Star Plus, Colors, Zee, Sony, Dangal and more). Every show with its full episode history by air date; plays direct MP4 from VKSpeed and Blogger (720p/360p, multi-part episodes listed as Part 1, 2, ...). Each link is checked before it is shown.

name: DesiSerials
description: DesiSerials (desi-serials.to, formerly desiserials.us) - daily Hindi TV serials and reality shows from Star Plus, Zee TV, Sony TV, Colors, Star Bharat, Sab TV and & TV, plus hundreds of completed shows. Episodes listed by air date; plays TVLogy HLS and VKSpeed / VkPrime MP4. Each link is checked before it is shown.

name: FMoviess
description: FMoviess (fmoviess.tv) — HD movies & TV shows with Trending / Latest rows. MoviesAPI multi-quality HLS with subtitles, plus a VidAPI/MovieBox backup for titles MoviesAPI lacks (and VixSrc where reachable). Every link is checked before it is shown.

name: HiCine
description: HiCine (hicine.sbs) — Bollywood & Hollywood movies, web series, K-dramas and anime in Hindi dual-audio. Direct 1080p/720p/480p files on FSL, Server 1, FSL v2 and PixelDrain; plot, rating and backdrop from TMDB.

name: Hindi Dubbed
description: Hindi Dubbed — Hollywood & South Indian Hindi-dubbed movies, Bollywood and Hindi cartoons from 20 official YouTube channels (Goldmines, Aditya, Shemaroo, Ultra, Pen, Rajshri, B4U…). Full movies as single items, web series grouped with episodes. Search finds full movies only.

name: KDramaMaza
description: KDramaMaza (kdramasmaza.net) — Korean, Chinese, Turkish & Japanese dramas plus anime in Hindi/Urdu dub. Full episode lists with direct HubCloud and GDFlix (Instant / Drive) files, checked before they are shown.

name: KatMovieHD
description: KatMovieHD — Hollywood & web series in Hindi dubbed / dual audio. Movies in every posted quality (StreamTape, HubCloud, GDFlix Instant / Drive), series with full episode lists and other seasons merged in. Links are checked before they are shown.

name: NetMirror
description: NetMirror (netmirror.center) - Netflix-style catalog: Bollywood, Hollywood, Anime and Reality TV, heavy on Hindi content. Direct files per title/episode (up to 1080p) with English subtitles where available. Every link is checked before it is shown; working links come first.

name: PikaHD
description: PikaHD (new.pikahd.co) — anime in Hindi dubbed, dual audio and English subbed: series with full episode lists and animated movies. Files from HubCloud, GDFlix and KMHD (StreamTape); links are checked before they are shown. Works without a VPN through the TJ-Plugins relay when the site is blocked on your network.

name: RareAnimes
description: RareAnimes / Rare Toons India (rareanimes.mov) - Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam dubbed anime, cartoons and animated movies. Every audio language an episode has is listed (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Untouched NF/CR), played as direct HD files from the site's StreamBeta servers; each link is checked before it is shown.

name: RiveStream
description: RiveStream (rivestream.ru) - TMDB-powered catalog of movies and TV shows, streamed from rivestream's server backends (Citadel, Prvibd, River, Kutti, Gbru, HindiSk) plus MhPly, AwsPly, VidPi and HDHub as fallbacks. Hindi audio is listed first, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali. Every link is checked before it is shown; working links come first.

name: SSR Movies
description: SSR Movies (ssrmovies.name) - Hindi dubbed and dual audio movies, Bollywood, Hollywood, web series, TV and WWE shows in 480p to 4K. Daily shows list every episode by date. Streams come from Watch (HLS), HubCloud, GDFlix and Direct-Cloud mirrors resolved to direct files; every link is checked before it is shown.

name: SubDubAnime
description: SubDubAnime (subdubanime.site) - Hindi and English dubbed/subbed anime: series, seasons and movies via the Blakite API. Every quality an episode has is offered (up to 1080p), highest first; each link is checked before it is shown.

name: Vidbox
description: Vidbox (vidbox.vc) - TMDB-powered catalog of movies and TV shows (vidbox uses TMDB ids, so titles match 1:1). Streams come from the Nxsha multi-language servers. Hindi audio is listed first, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali. Every link is checked before it is shown; working links come first.
